data.body: PS7 LLM-Review+1 PASS (2nd consecutive PASS, zero correctness findings = convergence). 2 non-blocking advisories, both test-sensitivity: (L409) negative 'no contamination' assertions in scenarios 3/8 read _keys_by_label(...)==[] immediately post-sync without an index-settle — a real false-NEGATIVE risk (index lag could hide leaked contamination -> spurious PASS). (L679) scenario 10's _InjectedScenarioFailure is synthetic (raised in-test), so it proves the harness's OWN cleanup wiring, not the product's internal cleanup path. Disposition: ACCEPT both for landing, HARDEN post-live. Neither can FAIL the green run; a false-negative stays green. Calibrating index-lag settle-barriers requires the DC's observed indexing timing, so guessing pre-live risks another wrong iteration (cf. the message-match / mutation-count advisories). Will revisit L409 with a settle barrier and L679's product-path coverage against the live run's observed behavior, filing follow-ups if warranted.
